title: Two to q hypercontractivity
statement: Let $S=\{-1,1\}$ have the uniform probability distribution, let $X(s)=s$, and let $q$ be a real number with $q>2$. For every $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$, the uniform $L^q$ norm of $a+bX/\sqrt{q-1}$ is at most the uniform $L^2$ norm of $a+bX$.
hypotheses_covered: The real value of $q$ is greater than $2$
